findings.summary: Custom Format.Set formats are no longer checked. This is now in the CHANGELOG (packages/agent/CHANGELOG.md:5) and ADR-0570 §3, and rests on a loud-throw-vs-annotation choice that is the user's call. Resolved as documented; kept as a note for the user question.

User confirmation of ADR-0569/0570 is now recorded with the user's quoted words in both ADRs' Corrections. I can read only the record, not the user's channel, so this is accepted as attribution. The upstream issue draft stays unfiled, correctly, since no explicit go was given.

The journal is a second message owner beside agent.state.messages. Its forcing constraint (CLI entry ids for firstKeptEntryId and omission targets) is restated in ADR-0569, and the port stays scoped to the reachable entries (message/compaction/null context_edit). No machinery beyond the contract found.

findings.summary: Seeded traces compare compaction reason/success only. tokensBefore/After are stripped in rand mode because rifty's ADR-0475 failed-tool receipts enter estimates, and a divergence in estimates would only show if it flipped a decision. Scripted scenarios keep exact numbers. This PR-4 change is acceptable as added coverage, not a replacement.

Two COI losses are classed ai-mode-ux: a pre-existing workspace-import toast timeout (draft backlog playground/workspace-import-success-observation-timeout, 2026-10-14). The csv-workflow-v5 drop across all Pi lanes, native included, is unisolated (n=3). Neither blocks by the Acceptance 8 clause; follow-up is optional.
